reference_sql:
WITH quarter_ends AS (
  -- one row per quarter end, December 2024 to December 2025 (fx_rates holds every day)
  SELECT MAX(rate_date) AS quarter_end
  FROM fx_rates
  WHERE rate_date >= DATE '2024-10-01'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('quarter', rate_date)
), mrr AS (
  -- one row per quarter end, every amount in euros at the 2025-12-31 rate
  SELECT q.quarter_end, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * fx.eur_per_unit) AS mrr_eur
  FROM quarter_ends q
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.event_date <= q.quarter_end
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates fx ON fx.currency = s.currency AND fx.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY q.quarter_end
), compared AS (
  -- one row per quarter end, with the quarter end before
  SELECT quarter_end, mrr_eur, LAG(mrr_eur) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_end) AS prev_mrr_eur
  FROM mrr
)
SELECT quarter_end, ROUND(mrr_eur, 2) AS mrr_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (mrr_eur - prev_mrr_eur) / prev_mrr_eur, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM compared
WHERE quarter_end >= DATE '2025-03-31'

solver.query:
WITH qe AS (
  SELECT MAX(rate_date) AS quarter_end FROM fx_rates
  WHERE rate_date >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND rate_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('quarter', rate_date)
), fx AS (
  SELECT currency, eur_per_unit FROM fx_rates WHERE rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
), mrr AS (
  SELECT q.quarter_end, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * COALESCE(f.eur_per_unit, 1)) AS mrr_eur
  FROM qe q
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.event_date <= q.quarter_end
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  LEFT JOIN fx f ON f.currency = s.currency
  GROUP BY q.quarter_end
), c AS (
  SELECT quarter_end, mrr_eur, LAG(mrr_eur) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_end) AS prev FROM mrr
)
SELECT quarter_end, ROUND(mrr_eur, 2) AS mrr_eur, ROUND((mrr_eur - prev) * 100.0 / prev, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM c WHERE quarter_end >= DATE '2025-03-31'
